MultiDeviceAlertPolicy.description: What a phone does with an alert while another device of the same user is in use.

oneOf.description: Wait about 15 seconds; reading the conversation elsewhere in that time cancels the alert.
Alert at once, as if no other device were in use.
Do not alert; only update the badge.

NotificationPreview.description: How much of a message a notification shows.

oneOf.description: Only who sent it; the body says that a message arrived.
Neither sender nor content: a generic title and body.

QuietHours.description: Do-not-disturb hours, in the device's local time.

allowMentions.description: Whether messages that mention the user still ring inside the window.

endMinute.description:
End, minute of the day (0..1439), exclusive. Equal to the start: all day. Smaller than the
start: the window crosses midnight.

startMinute.description: Start, minute of the day (0..1439), inclusive.

weekdays.description: Days the window starts on: bit0 Monday .. bit6 Sunday; 0 means every day.

description:
A partial update of the user's notification settings: items left out keep their value; at
least one item must be given.

baseSettingsVersion.description:
The settingsVersion the change is based on; 0 skips the check. When the stored settings
changed in the meantime the whole update is rejected: read them again and retry.

clearQuietHours.description: Remove the do-not-disturb hours. Rejected together with quietHours.

quietHours.description: New do-not-disturb hours, replacing the old ones.
